# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Night Rizz Runner: Neon Parkour Game` as a portrait-first browser game. Preserve the source mechanics: a Three.js 3D platform route, camera-relative joystick movement, a jump button, gravity, raycast floor contact, gap failure, collectible pickups worth +100, goal-tile win, restart, next route, and seeded route feed play. Transform the public identity into a satirical masked rooftop parkour game with synthwave neon city styling, anime speed-line energy, meme copy such as rizz and ez clap, and clear one-thumb mobile onboarding. The player should immediately read as a bat-eared neon runner, the collectibles as rizz tokens, the finish as a pink clap gate, and the failure as a viral faceplant. Use procedural CSS and Three.js geometry rather than stock images, keep the HUD readable in 4:7 to 9:16 portrait viewports, and avoid changing scoring, collisions, physics, or input semantics.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
- Original identity: `Package Dash 3D`, a mobile-first Three.js 3D route platformer with a courier/cat presentation.
- Objective: traverse a generated path of platforms, collect optional coins, and reach a goal tile.
- Inputs: left analog joystick for camera-relative movement, right jump button, menu buttons for start/routes/restart/next.
- Loop: build route, spawn player, run/jump with gravity, raycast downward for platform contact, collect items by distance, win on goal platform contact, fail when falling below the route.
- Score/progression: +100 per collectible, level index advances after goal, score resets on restart/next, community routes use seeded longer paths.

## Protected mechanics
- Three.js 3D platform traversal, tile size 2, playerSpeed 11, jumpForce 15, gravity 38, camera offset, generated route shape, joystick movement, jump impulse, raycast ground detection, collectible distance threshold, +100 scoring, goal win, fall fail, restart and next-level semantics.

## Rebuilt game blueprint
- Public identity: `Night Rizz Runner: Neon Parkour Game`.
- Focal role: a legally distinct bat-eared masked parkour athlete racing a meme commute across synthwave rooftops.
- Reinterpreted objects: old platforms become rooftop slabs, coins become rizz tokens, goal tile becomes clap gate, falling becomes viral faceplant.
- Canonical implementation: single inline `index.html`, using local Three.js only for stable mechanic fidelity.

## Safe transformation surfaces
- UI copy, HUD labels, title, route creator names, player mesh silhouette, material colors, platform/collectible/goal forms, background skyline/grid, feedback toasts, font and panel styling, route feed presentation.
